name: SYNAPSE SLAM: Neural-Physical Hybrid League
description: Athletes compete in a three-phase format: a physical obstacle course, a real-time neural strategy layer broadcast directly to spectator BCIs, and a final synchronization sprint where body and mind must operate in locked tandem at peak load. The Synapse Slam Governing Consortium — a joint venture between HelixCorp's entertainment division and three independent BCI hardware manufacturers — certifies arenas and athlete neural rigs, and the sport has become the fastest-growing league in GLMZ since its inaugural season. Spectators with BCIs can subscribe to an 'empathy-adjacent' feed that transmits a filtered version of a chosen athlete's neural load during the final phase.
story_hooks: A slam-rider discovers that a top athlete's neural feed contains what appears to be a second, hidden consciousness running parallel to her own — and the athlete has no idea.

A Tier 2 athlete with a black-market BCI rig manages to qualify for the Synapse Slam through a regional open and becomes a folk hero — until the Consortium's certification process threatens to disqualify her.
A neural-feed data broker is selling unredacted athlete consciousness profiles from the empathy-adjacent feed to undisclosed buyers, and a journalist needs an inside source to prove it.
